items.source: Creates a composite contributor from the beans of the given beanType retrieved from the given beanFactory.
items.translation: 从给定的 `beanFactory` 中检索给定 `beanType` 的 bean，并创建一个组合贡献者。

items.source: beanFactory - the bean factory from which the beans are retrieved
items.translation: beanFactory - 从中获取 Bean 的 Bean 工厂

items.source: beanType - the type of the beans that are retrieved
items.translation: beanType - 检索到的 Bean 的类型
